summary: TOP Ships Inc., a Greek-incorporated NYSE American-listed tanker owner, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 16, 2026 press release reporting first-half 2026 results: net income of $6.5 million, revenues of $25.5 million, EBITDA of $17.2 million, diluted EPS of $0.61, and stockholders' equity of $76.7 million as of June 30, 2026. The release also recaps an eight-vessel MR newbuilding program delivering 2028-2029, seven-year Trafigura charters worth $539.8 million, and three additional scrubber-fitted newbuildings on five-year oil-major charters adding $140.6 million. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
